title: Backloggd Asks Users to Reset Passwords Following Data Breach
excerpt: Users of the Backloggd platform are being prompted to log in again and update their account passwords after a security breach.
body_html:
The platform Backloggd has advised its users to update their account passwords following a security breach.

As a result of the incident, individuals who utilize the service may need to log into their accounts again and complete a password reset.
